cash_breakdown.item: Deposits and cash outside Mainland China, inferred from total deposits and cash less disclosed Mainland China cash
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Group-level cash at major financial institutions, but annual report does not split parent, Hong Kong and Singapore operating subsidiaries; operating subsidiary distribution and daily cinema liquidity uncertainty warrants ordinary operating subsidiary haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Deposits and cash were HK$258.617m; Mainland China cash was HK$4.112m, leaving HK$254.505m mainly outside Mainland China.

cash_breakdown.item: Deposits and cash placed with banks in Mainland China
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Annual report states remittance of Mainland China funds is subject to foreign exchange control rules; no evidence of immediate distributability.
cash_breakdown.reason: Small residual Mainland cash can be economically useful but is discounted heavily for cross-border and regulatory friction.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserve set conservatively at roughly 1.4 months of 2025 revenue to support Singapore cinema operations, working capital and cash flow volatility after Hong Kong closure.
cash_breakdown.reason: Management states cash and available facilities are needed for working capital; cinema operations require float for rent, film hire, payroll and suppliers.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Cash sits across Bermuda holding structure, Hong Kong, Singapore and Mainland China entities; no clean parent cash split or dividend route was disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Reserve covers extraction, withholding, currency and timing friction that is not separately quantifiable from the annual report.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: All bank loans were fully repaid as at 31 December 2025.
cash_breakdown.reason: No bank borrowing is deducted from detachable cash.

cash_breakdown.item: Lease liabilities for offices and Singapore cinemas
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: These are operating leases necessary to continue cinema operations, not financing attached to detachable cash; the cash burden is reflected in distributable cash profit and profit haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Recognised lease liabilities were HK$171.925m, including Singapore cinemas HK$168.505m.

profit_quality.assessment: 2025 turned profitable, but reported profit is not a clean recurring cash-profit base. Continuing operations profit included HK$85.849m gain on lease modification, HK$19.100m reversal of reinstatement provisions, HK$5.029m disposal gain, HK$9.087m exchange gain, HK$28.701m tax credit and HK$126.058m goodwill impairment. Operating cash flow was HK$114.264m, but after HK$6.214m property/intangible purchases and HK$79.382m lease principal payments, cash left before financing was about HK$28.668m. The main business is now concentrated in Singapore cinemas after Hong Kong closure, so only a conservative post-restructuring base is used.
adjustments: Used HK$30.0m as pre-haircut distributable cash profit, anchored to 2025 operating cash flow less capital purchases and lease principal rather than reported net profit alone.
Did not add back goodwill impairment mechanically to create a high recurring profit base because the impairment itself signals weaker Singapore cinema economics.
Applied 0.55 cash-profit haircut for cinema cyclicality, recent restructuring, one-year evidence after Hong Kong closure and lease cash burden.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2025 net operating cash flow HK$114.264m; 2024 HK$90.663m. 2025 purchase of property, plant and equipment HK$6.062m and intangible assets HK$0.152m. Lease principal paid HK$79.382m in 2025 and HK$113.427m in 2024.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Post-closure cash generation is positive but only one clean year is visible, while cinema attendance and film supply remain volatile and leases consume material cash.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Reported profit converted into operating cash in 2025, but this is inflated by non-cash/non-recurring lease and impairment accounting and needs lease principal deduction for owner cash.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 2025 cash purchases of PPE and intangibles were HK$6.214m; this is low after HK closure and may understate normalized refurbishment needs.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Working capital released cash in 2025 through lower receivables, deposits/prepayments and deferred income; this is not assumed to recur at the same level.
